review_state.title: Build Your Brand: AI-Driven Marketing for Founders
review_state.description: Founders struggle to stay consistent and visible. Here's how AI-driven marketing helps you get your brand made without burning your calendar or budget.
review_state.preview_text: Most founders know their brand matters. They just never have the hour to do anything about it. The pitch deck gets updated, the product ships, the team grows, and the brand stays stuck somewhere between the logo file and a half-finished content calendar no one touched last quarter.
